# Persis Ford

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P56](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0056), [v5 CHAPTER XXX. THE GHOST ON THE DYKE P1](../source/v05-c30.md#nw-v05-c30-p0001)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Persis Ford is a woman of wonderful beauty who possesses a distinct city glamour. Described as being just like a picture, her striking appearance is notable to those who hear of her.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P56](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0056), [v5 CHAPTER XXX. THE GHOST ON THE DYKE P1](../source/v05-c30.md#nw-v05-c30-p0001)_

## History

Persis Ford was a deceased resident of [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) St. Mary whose grave was located in the old [Methodist](../codex/factions.md#methodist) cemetery. During a conversation in the graveyard, [Faith Meredith](../character/faith.md) remarked on Persis's name, noting how pretty it was.
